For years, his formula has been clear:

Remake a story that already worked

Replace depth with elevation shots and attitude

Confuse volume for emotion

Package déjà-vu as innovation

It’s cinematic cosplay — glossy, muscular, postured… and hollow enough to echo.

Visionary directors push boundaries. Harsha pushes filters and fog machines.

There is only so much slo-mo a script can carry before the story collapses under the sheer weight of its own self-importance — and Bhimaa and Baaghi 4 proved that in 4K clarity.

Style with substance is cinema.
Style without substance is a two-hour perfume commercial with fight scenes.
